use default

repeat(form: string, times: int) -> Pipe[string] is
    for _ in 1::times do
        yield form
    od
si

euclid(pulses: int, steps: int) -> string is
    let first mut = "1"
    let first_count mut = pulses
    let second mut = "0"
    let second_count mut = steps - pulses

    while second_count > 1 do
        let fewer = System.Math.min(first_count, second_count)
        let leftover =
            if first_count > second_count then first else second fi
        let leftover_count = first_count + second_count - 2 * fewer

        first = "{first}{second}"
        first_count = fewer
        second = leftover
        second_count = leftover_count
    od

    let left = repeat(first, first_count) |> join("")
    let right = repeat(second, second_count) |> join("")

    return "{left}{right}"
si

let pairs = [(2, 5), (3, 7), (4, 9), (5, 12), (5, 13), (7, 16)]

for (pulses, steps) in pairs do
    write_line("E({pulses},{steps}) = {euclid(pulses, steps)}")
